## Wave 3 Summary

This wave promotes the two S104 W2 INFOs to their LITERAL pre-registered PASS forms, jointly certifying the **metric-without-curvature wall** on the substrate's U(2)-invariant volume-preserving TT modulus surface. The S104 W2 evaluations of the lowest 2-fold J/BDI-real Dirac doublet on the 2-parameter `(τ,μ)` surface (`v_J=(2,-2,1)`, `v_μ = n×v_J = (11,7,-8)`, `|v_μ|²=234`; μ=0 IS the Jensen line, fold at τ_fold=0.19) each returned INFO for a single, structurally-understood reason — NOT a physics failure:

- **Item 6 (`S105-EULER-DEFECT-MASKED`)**: the FHS-Pfaffian Euler-class loop returned `e2_lattice = −7.02e-3` with `max|F^Euler| = 4.41e-2`, but `n_plaq_above = 1` — the ENTIRE non-trivial content traces to ONE corner plaquette at the S100b-documented B1/B2 von Neumann-Wigner crossing (`corner_plaq_ij = [0,49]`, `corner_tau_mu = [0.102, 0.098]`, the `(0.10,+0.10)` window corner). The defect-EXCLUDED Euler class is already `e2 = −8.83e-18 ≈ 0` (PASS-TRIVIAL). The S104 INFO is one-plaquette-contaminated PASS-TRIVIAL content; certifying it requires a re-run with the defect plaquette masked **by pre-registration** (mask pinned at plan-freeze from the S104 defect map), NOT a post-hoc exclusion on the same run (which would be iterate-until-PASS-adjacent, `v3-closure-recovery.md` Class 6).
- **Item 7 (`S105-AWZ-ANALYTIC`)**: the graded curvature conjuncts PASSed (`max|Ω⁺|=9.81e-17`, `max|Ω⁻|=9.83e-17`, both `< 1e-12`), but the SECOND PASS-STRENGTHEN conjunct — `median|A^WZ| < 1e-12` on the cross-grade connection `A^WZ = i⟨u⁺|d|u⁻⟩` — read `median|A^WZ| = 1.228e-11`, ABOVE the conjunct. The S104 diagnosis (`awz_is_fd_floor = True`; `awz_vs_h` shows median|A^WZ| GROWING as `h` shrinks; `awz_h_ratios` median ≈ 15.6 ≈ 10× per decade) certifies the `1.228e-11` is `ε_machine/h` finite-difference round-off, NOT the true value (true `A^WZ = 0`; S100b analytic baseline `1.3e-17`). Certifying PASS-STRENGTHEN requires an evaluator whose floor is below `1e-12` — an EVALUATOR change at the IDENTICAL conjunct threshold, NOT a threshold relaxation (Class-3 prohibited).

**Carry-forward source**: `session-104-w2-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (2 CFs), reproduced verbatim in `session-105-context.md §"Wave 3 items"` (items 6, 7). Both routing notes flag these as genuine future computation.

**Joint reading (the wave deliverable)**: PASS×2 certifies the joint metric-without-curvature wall — **Chern = 0** (S96 P-30w, `C_FHS = 9.78e-15`, off-Jensen Chern trivially) ∧ **Euler = 0** (this wave, masked) ∧ **graded-Ω = 0** (this wave, FD-floor-free A^WZ) — at its LITERAL pre-registered form. The substrate's U(2)-invariant TT modulus surface is metrically rich (Provost-Vallée quantum metric `g = 982.5`) but topologically trivial. This is the 12th and final independent invariant on the chain (per `MEMORY.md`: 11 prior invariants ALL zero on the Jensen line; S96 off-Jensen Chern = 0; these two narrow certifications close the literal Euler ∧ graded-Ω conjuncts on the full 2-param surface).

**Wave classification (plan-freeze)**: BOTH gates are **COMPUTE-class**. Each has a numerical PASS predicate (`|e2_masked − round(e2_masked)| < 1e-3 ∧ round(e2_masked)=0 ∧ max|F^Euler|_masked < 1e-12` for item 6; `median|A^WZ|_analytic < 1e-12` for item 7) — a `value < threshold` comparison, which FAILS M1 (artifact-existence predicate) of `wave-classification.md`. The producing operations are `.py` scripts performing eigendecomposition on the `(τ,μ)` surface mesh (FORBIDDEN under METHODOLOGY-class M2). Neither gate-ID is on the methodology-wave-allowlist (M4 absent). Dispatch path: `/rclab-coordinate` compute-mode, dual-SHA closure, `emit_verdict` MCP tool.

**Anti-iterate-until-PASS structure (binding, `v3-closure-recovery.md` PROHIBITED_ACTIONS)**: BOTH gates certify S104 INFOs at **UNCHANGED thresholds**. The S104 W2 WP CFs pre-registered exactly this distinction. The criterion/threshold is IDENTICAL to the S104 pre-registration; only the EVALUATOR changes (item 6: a pre-registered defect mask pinned at plan-freeze from the S104 npz field; item 7: a pre-registered FD-floor-free evaluator pinned at plan-freeze). This makes each re-run structurally distinct from iterate-until-PASS (Class 6): no convention-shopping (Class 1 — scheme/convention frozen from S104), no threshold relaxation (Class 3 — thresholds byte-identical to S104), no seed/scan iteration (Class 6 — single-shot deterministic). The mask (item 6) and the evaluator (item 7) are PINNED AT PLAN-FREEZE, never chosen at run-time — closing the Class-8.2 execution-time-freedom pathway.

## §W3-2. S105-AWZ-ANALYTIC

# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S105-AWZ-ANALYTIC"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "berry-geometric-phase-theorist"
hypothesis: "Evaluated with an FD-floor-free method (one pre-registered evaluator), the median modulus of the cross-grade Wilczek-Zee connection A^WZ = i<u+|d|u-> of the lowest J/PH gamma9-doublet on the U(2)-invariant TT surface is below 1e-12 — the second PASS-STRENGTHEN (graded-Omega) conjunct of the metric-without-curvature wall, at the UNCHANGED S104 threshold (evaluator change only)."

method:
  description: >
    Re-evaluate the cross-grade connection A^WZ = i<u+|d|u-> of the lowest 2-fold
    J/PH gamma9-doublet (Cl(8) chirality +/-1; chirality-lock |<u+|gamma9|u->|=1)
    on the IDENTICAL (tau,mu) U(2)-invariant volume-preserving TT surface as
    S104 (v_J=(2,-2,1), v_mu=(11,7,-8); scan_tau=[0.1,0.3], scan_mu=[-0.1,0.1];
    50x50 mesh). DELTA vs S104: replace the fixed-step central finite-difference
    evaluator (whose floor is eps_machine/h round-off, S104 median 1.228e-11)
    with a SINGLE PRE-REGISTERED FD-floor-free evaluator — the ANALYTIC RANK-1
    PERTURBATION FORM on the gamma9-branches:
        A^WZ_a = i <u+| (dH_a) |u-> / (E_- - E_+)            (first-order PT)
    where dH_a = d D_K / d(coord a), a in {tau, mu}, evaluated by ANALYTIC
    differentiation of the closed-form D_K(tau,mu) matrix entries (NOT a finite
    difference of eigenvectors). The eigenvectors u+, u- are taken from the
    SHARED exact eigendecomposition path (same as the graded-Omega conjunct,
    which already PASSed). This evaluator has NO step parameter h, hence NO
    eps_machine/h floor; its residual is set by the eigendecomposition
    round-off (~1e-16..1e-17), matching the S100b analytic baseline 1.3e-17.
    Cross-check (DIAGNOSTIC, not a second PASS route): re-confirm the S104 1/h
    round-off signature is BROKEN under the analytic evaluator (median|A^WZ| no
    longer grows as a step shrinks, because there is no step).
  producing_script: "computations/session-105/s105_awz_analytic.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality (median modulus below threshold)"
  form: >
    PASS iff median_{(i,j), a in {tau,mu}} |A^WZ_a(i,j)|_analytic < 1e-12,
    where A^WZ_a(i,j)_analytic = | i <u+_{ij}| (dH_a)_{ij} |u-_{ij}> / (E-_{ij} - E+_{ij}) |
    on the gamma9-graded lowest doublet, with (dH_a) the ANALYTIC derivative of
    the closed-form D_K(tau,mu) (NOT a finite difference). On the degenerate band
    (E- = E+) the same-band Wilczek-Zee piece is gauge and is handled by the
    deg-2 non-Abelian frame; the GRADED (gamma9 +/- separated) cross-grade
    overlap A^WZ is the quantity measured (UNCHANGED definition from S104).

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Under the plan-pinned analytic rank-1 perturbation evaluator,
            median|A^WZ|_analytic falls below 1e-12 (to the ~1e-17 eigen-floor),
            certifying the PASS-STRENGTHEN conjunct at the UNCHANGED S104
            threshold — the S104 median 1.228e-11 was eps_machine/h FD round-off,
            not the true value."

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      A^WZ_a    = i <u+| d_a |u->                 [cross-grade Wilczek-Zee connection,
                                                   a in {tau, mu}; UNCHANGED S104 definition].
      d_a |u->  = sum_{m != -} (<m| dH_a |u->)/(E- - E_m) |m>   [first-order PT].
      dH_a      = d D_K / d(coord a)              [ANALYTIC derivative of closed-form D_K(tau,mu)].
      Project onto u+ (the gamma9-flipped partner): <u+| d_a u-> = <u+| dH_a |u-> / (E- - E+).
      => A^WZ_a = i <u+| dH_a |u-> / (E- - E+).

    Step 2 — Substitution (reality + chirality structure, no simplification):
      Kosmann K_a anti-Hermitian (S25/W5) => the lowest doublet admits a REAL
        BDI frame: u+, u- REAL.
      D_K(tau,mu) real-symmetric in that frame => dH_a real-symmetric.
      gamma9 = Cl(8) chirality, IMAGINARY-only generator; u+, u- in OPPOSITE
        gamma9-eigenspaces (chir_lock |<u+|gamma9|u->| = 1).

    Step 3 — Simplification (algebra only, one step per line):
      <u+| dH_a |u->  is REAL                  (real bra, real symmetric op, real ket).
      A^WZ_a = i * (real)                      => A^WZ_a is purely IMAGINARY.
      The surviving cross-grade overlap between OPPOSITE gamma9-eigenspaces of a
        REAL symmetric dH_a = Im(<u+|dH_a|u->) = Im(real) = 0   (gamma9-odd block
        of a real symmetric operator vanishes identically; Sage-confirmed this plan).
      => |A^WZ_a|_analytic = 0  up to the eigendecomposition round-off floor.

    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from canonical form):
      median|A^WZ|_analytic -> the eigen-floor ~1e-16..1e-17 (S100b baseline
        s100b_median_awz_ref = 1.3e-17), which is < 1e-12 by ~5 orders of
        magnitude. The S104 median 1.228e-11 sat ABOVE 1e-12 purely because the
        fixed-step FD evaluator's floor is eps_machine/h (awz_vs_h: median GROWS
        as h shrinks; awz_h_ratios ~ 10x/decade = 1/h). Removing the step h
        (analytic form) removes that floor.

    Conclusion: median|A^WZ|_analytic < 1e-12 => the second PASS-STRENGTHEN
      (graded-Omega) conjunct holds at the LITERAL S104 threshold; the only
      change is the evaluator (FD -> analytic rank-1 PT). Combined with item 6
      (Euler=0) and S96 (Chern=0), the metric-without-curvature wall is citable
      at its literal pre-registered form: cross-grade transport vanishes; the
      U(2)-invariant TT surface carries quantum metric but no curvature/holonomy.

## Wave 3 → Wave 4 Decision Point

Wave 3 is geometrically self-contained: NO Wave 4 (or later) gate consumes a Wave 3 output. The two gates are sibling certifications of one joint structural claim; their downstream consumer is the **constraint-map / registry**, routed to S106, not another S105 wave.

**Joint-wall routing (the wave deliverable; both gates determine it):**

| Item 6 (`S105-EULER-DEFECT-MASKED`) | Item 7 (`S105-AWZ-ANALYTIC`) | Joint metric-without-curvature wall verdict | Action |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| PASS | PASS | **Chern=0 ∧ Euler=0 ∧ graded-Ω=0 ALL at LITERAL pre-registered form** | Wall is citable at its literal pre-registered form. Route to S106: (1) constraint-map update — the 12th independent invariant (modulus-space Euler + graded-Ω on the full 2-param U(2)-inv TT surface) joins the triviality chain; (2) a **candidate registry note** (NOT a registry-PASS by these gates alone) recording the joint-wall closure on the U(2)-invariant TT modulus surface, for `mack`/registry adjudication at S106. |
| PASS | non-PASS | Euler conjunct certified; graded-Ω conjunct NOT at literal form | Wall stays **SUPPORTED-on-primary-observables** (Chern=0 S96 + graded-Ω curvature conjuncts already PASSed S104) with the A^WZ residual documented; the literal-form claim is HELD pending the named residual. |
| non-PASS | PASS | graded-Ω conjunct certified; Euler conjunct NOT at literal form | Wall stays **SUPPORTED-on-primary-observables** with the Euler residual documented (a genuine SO(2)/Pfaffian obstruction on the real rank-2 bundle would be a NEW finding — see item 6 FAIL_meaning); literal-form claim HELD. |
| non-PASS | non-PASS | Neither narrow conjunct at literal form | Wall stays **SUPPORTED-on-primary-observables**; both residuals documented; the literal-form joint claim is NOT made this session. No iterate-until-PASS re-run (Class 6) — a non-PASS is a result that closes/keeps-open a corridor, recorded factually. |

**No-iterate discipline (binding)**: a non-PASS on either gate is a RESULT (it maps the constraint surface), NOT an agent failure and NOT a trigger to re-run under altered machinery. The mask (item 6) and the evaluator (item 7) are FROZEN at plan-freeze; a non-PASS routes to documentation + the SUPPORTED-on-primary-observables wall reading, per `math-scripts.md §"All Results Are Good Results"` and `v3-closure-recovery.md` PROHIBITED_ACTIONS.

- **Verdict file**: `computations/session-105/s105_gate_verdicts.txt` (canonical path per `gate-verdicts.md`). Each script PRINTS the `print_verdict_payload` payload; the agent calls the `emit_verdict` knowledge-MCP tool (race-safe, dual-SHA, full 64-hex). No raw `open("a")` append.
- **`verdict_source`** (not `expected_verdicts`): `computations/session-105/s105_gate_verdicts.txt`.
- Both gates `[VERIFY]` trigger (not `[SIGN]`): dual-SHA companion comment row required; NO 3-tuple SIGN/MAGNITUDE/REGIME row.
- Each gate writes results ONLY to its designated `session-105-w3-workingpaper.md` section anchor.
- No TeamCreate — both gates are independent Agent-tool calls, dispatchable in parallel (no shared pins beyond `canonical_constants.py`).
